note: All 188 pivots are Early Modern Irish medical/herbal prose (G600005 herbal, G600008 medical treatise) translated or adapted from Latin school medicine (Avicenna, Platearius, Macer, Galen). Partners are mostly Greek medical/philosophical prose, Cato De agri cultura, ON/OHG religious and legal prose, matched on generic vocabulary (water, herb, flower, red, white). No shared collocation in congruent context that I would defend as inherited; the recurrent Irish formulas (loscadh teineadh no uisce, greim na con confaidh, osluigidh duinti na n-ae ocus na seilge) are translations of Latin medical phrasing and have no cognate partner wording. No claims.
